dish.title: Lebanese Baked Kibbeh with Pine Nuts, Yogurt-Cucumber Salad, and Fattoush-Style Greens
dish.description: A tray of kibbeh bil sanieh: a shell of fine bulgur kneaded with ground lamb, onion, and seven-spice layered around a filling of spiced lamb, onion, and toasted pine nuts, scored into diamonds, drizzled with olive oil, and baked until crisp-edged. Served with a garlicky yogurt-cucumber salad and a lemony tomato-cucumber salad.

recipe_version.title: Lebanese Baked Kibbeh with Pine Nuts, Yogurt-Cucumber Salad, and Fattoush-Style Greens
recipe_version.description: A tray of kibbeh bil sanieh: a shell of fine bulgur kneaded with ground lamb, onion, and seven-spice layered around a filling of spiced lamb, onion, and toasted pine nuts, scored into diamonds, drizzled with olive oil, and baked until crisp-edged. Served with a garlicky yogurt-cucumber salad and a lemony tomato-cucumber salad.

ingredients.name: lean ground lamb
ingredients.note: 1 1/4 lb for the shell, 3/4 lb for the filling

ingredients.name: yellow onions
ingredients.note: 1 quartered for the shell, 1 finely chopped for the filling

ingredients.name: Lebanese seven-spice (baharat)
ingredients.display_name: Lebanese seven-spice whose label lists spices only

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp shell, 1/2 tsp filling, 1/4 tsp yogurt salad, 1/2 tsp tomato salad

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp filling, 1/4 cup top, 3 tbsp tomato salad

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the bulgur and soak it in 2 cups cold water. Quarter one onion and finely chop the other. Dice the cucumbers and tomatoes, chop the parsley, grate the garlic, and juice the lemon.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.body: While the bulgur soaks, toast the pine nuts in a dry 10-inch skillet over medium until golden, about 3 minutes, and set aside. Add 1 tbsp olive oil and the chopped onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add 3/4 lb lamb, 1 tsp seven-spice, and 1/2 tsp salt and cook, breaking it up, until browned, about 7 minutes. Stir in the pine nuts and cool slightly.

steps.title: Make the shell
steps.body: Drain the bulgur in a fine strainer and press out as much liquid as possible. Pulse the quartered onion in a food processor until fine, then add 1 1/4 lb lamb, the bulgur, 2 tsp seven-spice, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and 3 tbsp ice-cold water and process to a smooth, sticky paste, about 1 minute, working in two batches if needed.

steps.title: Preheat and layer
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 400 F. Oil a 9x13-inch dish. With wet hands, press half the shell mixture into an even layer on the bottom. Spread the filling over it. Flatten the remaining shell mixture into patties in your palms and lay them over the filling, pressing the seams together and smoothing with wet hands.

steps.title: Score and bake
steps.body: Score the top into diamonds with a knife, cutting down to the filling, and press a small hole in the center of each. Pour 1/4 cup olive oil over the top and bake until deep golden-brown with crisp edges and 160 F inside, about 35 minutes. Rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Make the salads
steps.body: During the bake, stir the yogurt with half the cucumbers, the garlic, mint, and 1/4 tsp salt. Toss the tomatoes, remaining cucumbers, parsley, lemon juice, 3 tbsp olive oil, sumac, and 1/2 tsp salt (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Cut along the scored lines and serve squares or diamonds of kibbeh with the yogurt salad and tomato salad.

coverage_contribution: Lebanese 1 to 2 (lebanese-samke-harra-bulgur is the other) and the first Lebanese meat main. Baked layered kibbeh is a new format.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with lebanese-samke-harra-bulgur: a lamb-and-bulgur bake with pine nuts and yogurt salad, not fish with tahini. Compared with spiced-lamb-meatballs: layered baked kibbeh with a bulgur shell, not meatballs. Compared with south-african-bobotie: bulgur-and-lamb layers with pine nuts, not a curried mince under an egg custard. Compared with persian-lamb-koobideh-saffron-rice in this wave: baked with bulgur, not grilled kebabs.
not_duplicate_of: Not fried kibbeh balls (deep-fried stuffed shells are fiddly and close to the closed dumpling format).
